content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"In-home personal care and home health serving elderly and disabled clients, paid by government programs; not education."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Online and campus degree and certificate programs for adult learners, funded by student tuition and federal aid, like the target."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Professional employer organization and payroll services for businesses, plus insurance; no education offering."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Sells enrollment marketing and recruiting services to one university; does not sell education to students."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Consulting and managed services for hospitals, universities and companies; does not deliver education to students."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Tuition-funded accredited postsecondary schools training adult students for careers, with campus-based delivery and regulatory oversight, similar to the target."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Online and campus degree and certificate programs for working adults, funded by student tuition and federal aid, matching the target."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Contract engineering, healthcare and IT staffing billed on time; supplies workers rather than education."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Virtual K-12 schools sold mainly to public districts; serves children and public systems, not adult degree learners."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Commercial insurance brokerage and program administration earning carrier commissions; no education business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Skilled nursing, senior living and home health operator serving patients and residents; not education."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Tuition-based postsecondary career training at campuses with federal aid; hands-on trades focus differs from degree programs but the model matches."}]}
